cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.
